passages.text: Then the men of Ephraim assembled and crossed the Jordan to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, “Why have you crossed over to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We will burn your house down with you inside!”
passages.sermon:
The men of Ephraim gathered together.
They crossed the Jordan River.
They went to the city of Zaphon.
They spoke to Jephthah.
They said, “Why did you cross over to fight the Ammonites?
Why did you not call us to go with you?
We will burn your house down with you inside.”
passages.original: וַיִּצָּעֵק֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר צָפ֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ לְיִפְתָּ֜ח מַדּ֣וּעַ׀ עָבַ֣רְתָּ׀ לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּבְנֵי־ עַמּ֗וֹן וְלָ֙נוּ֙ לֹ֤א קָרָ֙אתָ֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת עִמָּ֔ךְ בֵּיתְךָ֕ נִשְׂרֹ֥ף עָלֶ֖יךָ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: But Jephthah replied, “My people and I had a serious conflict with the Ammonites, and when I called, you did not save me out of their hands.
passages.sermon:
Jephthah was a leader of Israel.
Jephthah spoke to the men of Ephraim.
Jephthah said, “I and my people had a great conflict with the Ammonites.
I called for your help.
You did not save me from their power.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ רִ֗יב הָיִ֛יתִי אֲנִ֛י וְעַמִּ֥י וּבְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֖וֹן מְאֹ֑ד וָאֶזְעַ֣ק אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ הוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י מִיָּדָֽם׃

passages.text: When I saw that you would not save me, I risked my life and crossed over to the Ammonites, and the LORD delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come today to fight against me?”
passages.sermon:
Jephthah was the leader of Gilead.
Jephthah spoke to the men of Ephraim.
Jephthah saw that the men of Ephraim would not save him.
Jephthah decided to risk his own life.
Jephthah crossed over to fight the Ammonites.
The LORD gave the Ammonites into Jephthah’s hand.
Jephthah asked the men of Ephraim a question.
He said, “Why have you come today to fight against me?”
passages.original: וָֽאֶרְאֶ֞ה כִּֽי־ אֵינְךָ֣ מוֹשִׁ֗יע וָאָשִׂ֨ימָה נַפְשִׁ֤י בְכַפִּי֙ וָֽאֶעְבְּרָה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּיָדִ֑י וְלָמָ֞ה עֲלִיתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֛י הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בִּֽי׃

passages.text: Jephthah then gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”
passages.sermon:
Jephthah was the leader of Gilead.
He gathered all the men of Gilead.
Jephthah and the men of Gilead fought against the tribe of Ephraim.
The men of Gilead defeated the men of Ephraim.
The men of Gilead struck down the men of Ephraim.
The Ephraimites had insulted the Gileadites.
The Ephraimites said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim.”
They said, “You live among Ephraim and Manasseh.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יִפְתָּח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם אֶת־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיַּכּוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶת־ אֶפְרַ֗יִם כִּ֤י אָמְרוּ֙ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם גִּלְעָ֕ד בְּת֥וֹךְ אֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּת֥וֹךְ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a fugitive from Ephraim would say, “Let me cross over,” the Gileadites would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he answered, “No,” they told him, “Please say Shibboleth.” If he said, “Sibboleth,” because he could not pronounce it correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. So at that time 42,000 Ephraimites were killed.
passages.sermon:
The Gileadites were men from Gilead.
They captured the fords of the Jordan River.
These fords led to the land of Ephraim.
Fugitives from Ephraim tried to cross the river.
A fugitive would say, “Let me cross over.”
The Gileadites would question him.
They would ask, “Are you an Ephraimite?”
If the man answered, “No,” the Gileadites would test him.
They would say, “Please say Shibboleth.”
An Ephraimite could not pronounce the word correctly.
He would say, “Sibboleth” instead.
He could not say it the right way.
The Gileadites would seize him.
They would kill him at the fords of the Jordan.
At that time, the Gileadites killed 42,000 men from Ephraim.
passages.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֥ד גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶֽת־ מַעְבְּר֥וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְֽ֠הָיָה כִּ֣י יֹאמְר֞וּ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶעֱבֹ֔רָה וַיֹּ֨אמְרוּ ל֧וֹ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ גִלְעָ֛ד הַֽאֶפְרָתִ֥י אַ֖תָּה וַיֹּ֥אמֶֽר׀ לֹֽא׃ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לוֹ֩ אֱמָר־ נָ֨א שִׁבֹּ֜לֶת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר סִבֹּ֗לֶת וְלֹ֤א יָכִין֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר כֵּ֔ן וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּ אוֹת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁחָט֖וּהוּ אֶל־ מַעְבְּר֣וֹת הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיִּפֹּ֞ל בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: Jephthah judged Israel six years, and when he died, he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
passages.sermon:
Jephthah was a leader of Israel.
He judged Israel for six years.
Jephthah was from Gilead.
Jephthah died.
People buried Jephthah in a city of Gilead.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַיָּ֗מָת יִפְתָּח֙ הַגִּלְעָדִ֔י וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעָרֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד׃פ

passages.text: After Jephthah, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
passages.sermon:
Ibzan came from Bethlehem.
Jephthah died.
After Jephthah died, Ibzan became judge over Israel.
Ibzan judged Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִבְצָ֖ן מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: He had thirty sons, as well as thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage to men outside his clan; and for his sons he brought back thirty wives from elsewhere. Ibzan judged Israel seven years.
passages.sermon:
Ibzan came from Bethlehem.
Ibzan judged Israel.
He judged Israel for seven years.
Ibzan had thirty sons.
Ibzan had thirty daughters.
He sent his thirty daughters to marry men outside his clan.
He brought thirty wives from outside for his sons.
passages.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים בָּנוֹת֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח הַח֔וּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנ֔וֹת הֵבִ֥יא לְבָנָ֖יו מִן־ הַח֑וּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Ibzan died, and he was buried in Bethlehem.
passages.sermon:
Ibzan judged Israel after Jephthah.
Ibzan came from Bethlehem.
Ibzan died.
People buried Ibzan in Bethlehem.

passages.text: After Ibzan, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel ten years.
passages.sermon: Elon was from the tribe of Zebulun.\r\nElon became judge of Israel after Ibzan.\r\nElon judged Israel for ten years.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵיל֖וֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Elon the Zebulunite died, and he was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
passages.sermon:
Elon was from the tribe of Zebulun.
Elon died.
People buried Elon in Aijalon.
Aijalon is in the land of Zebulun.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת אֵל֣וֹן הַזְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּאַיָּל֖וֹן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ זְבוּלֻֽן׃פ

passages.text: After Elon, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, judged Israel.
passages.sermon: Abdon was the son of Hillel.\r\nAbdon came from Pirathon.\r\nAbdon judged Israel after Elon.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אַחֲרָ֖יו אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־ הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. And he judged Israel eight years.
passages.sermon:
Abdon son of Hillel was from Pirathon.
Abdon judged Israel.
Abdon judged Israel for eight years.
Abdon had forty sons.
Abdon had thirty grandsons.
Abdon’s sons and grandsons rode on seventy donkeys.
passages.original: וַיְהִי־ ל֞וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים רֹכְבִ֖ים עַל־ שִׁבְעִ֣ים עֲיָרִ֑ם וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, died, and he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
passages.sermon:
Abdon was the son of Hillel.
Abdon came from Pirathon.
Abdon judged Israel.
Abdon died.
People buried Abdon at Pirathon.
Pirathon is in the land of Ephraim.
Pirathon is in the hill country of the Amalekites.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛מָת עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן־ הִלֵּ֖ל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֑י וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּהַ֖ר הָעֲמָלֵקִֽי׃פ
